raw_response:
Last season I did not put chemical fertilizer on this root crop plot, and I will stay that way again because cash is tight and most people around me also grow cassava and sweet potato without buying fertilizer. I own this land, so I will carry some manure to the plot and use the better cuttings I can get from farmers nearby, but I will not pay for irrigation. I will spray a little herbicide to reduce weeding work, and for the rest I will use family labor and only bring in a few hired people when planting and harvesting are heavy.
